prerequisite: Text conjunction 9PG equivalent, but whole-request effect fails contractual criterion; legacy text proof remains default. Measured marginal legacy text group0.136/0.119s supports only an equivalent access-strategy experiment.
hypothesis: Unknown-text ID subqueries may use narrow partial indexes over the same current row predicates. PostgreSQL maintains ordinary index membership transactionally; no eligibility column/materialized view/app cache and no normal runtime schema change. Must distinguish grouping from physical index effect.
scenario: Two10000 fixtures unchanged. A=current row proof; B=unknown-ID set without index; C=same set with partial index, actual SQL-only prototype. Four counterbalanced triplets per listing/search; index DDL toggled explicitly, outside timers, every sample preceded by warmup. Statistics prepared after off-page writes/rollback tests. Params/outputs/code identical within family.
criteria: Combined row-indexed median paired saving averaged across listing/search >=max(0.05s,15%average row median) AND >=3/4 favorable. Separate index-only set-indexed saving median>=0.05s AND>=3/4 favorable. Both fixtures required. Verify actual index use in separate plans before crediting index mechanism. Prototype positive vectors must match complete original ordered vectors for all valid rows, off-page invalid/valid-unknown text and rate updates, and rollback. Not native ineligibility, HTTP improvement or capacity.
plans: Four separate EXPLAIN(ANALYZE,BUFFERS) READ ONLY after paired controls: row/noindex listing; set/noindex listing; indexed listing/search. Report actual node rows/loops only, not inferred rows_scanned.
finish: Terminal source/hash/own cleanup and expression/index-use/paired effects reviewed before any migration or application route is adopted. No load or concurrent build/test. Keep all prior insufficiencies and FAIL/INVALID untouched.
limitations: DDL toggles schema and warms buffers; warmup standardizes warm reads but does not establish production cache behavior. Query shape/index effects both retained. Write overhead/capacity, full native integration, per-rule metrics and matrix absent. Django local PostgreSQL backend disables prepare_threshold by default and uses client binding; actual index plan must be inspected, not assumed from this setting.
